Set numeric `data-width` and `data-height` on the entry composition root.

findings.message: CSS declaration `transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` runs on the browser clock and cannot be seeked deterministically across render workers.
findings.fixHint: Keep the class or attribute swap for state; put the visual change on the paused GSAP timeline.

findings.message: CSS declaration `transition: color 0.1s ease, transform 0.1s ease` runs on the browser clock and cannot be seeked deterministically across render workers.
findings.fixHint: Keep the class or attribute swap for state; put the visual change on the paused GSAP timeline.

findings.message: <audio id="master-audio"> has src but no data-start. HyperFrames cannot own playback for untimed media, so preview and render behavior can diverge.
findings.fixHint: Add data-start="0" (or the intended start time) and data-duration if the clip should stop before the source ends.

findings.message: Inline <script> imperatively controls managed media via currentTime. HyperFrames must own media play/pause/seek to keep preview, timeline, and renders deterministic.
findings.fixHint: Remove imperative media play/pause/currentTime/muted control. Express timing with data-start/data-duration and media offsets like data-media-start or data-playback-start instead.

findings.message: "#cinema-top" has CSS `transform: translateY(-140px)` and a GSAP tween animates y. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: translateY(-140px)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: y: -140. Example: tl.fromTo('#cinema-top', { y: -140 }, { y: -140, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.

findings.message: "#cinema-bottom" has CSS `transform: translateY(140px)` and a GSAP tween animates y. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: translateY(140px)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: y: 140. Example: tl.fromTo('#cinema-bottom', { y: 140 }, { y: 140, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.

findings.message: GSAP timeline is created but never registered in window.__timelines. The runtime discovers timelines from this registry. Without registration, animations will not play during preview or render.
findings.fixHint: Add `window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};` and `window.__timelines["root"] = tl;` after creating the timeline (use the composition's data-composition-id as the key).

findings.message: GSAP tween on "#playhead" uses motion that snaps to integer device pixels: left. Layout and text-reflow properties snap during browser layout; roundProps rounds the tween value. Slow motion or an ease-out tail then stutters under the seek-by-frame capture engine. Animate transforms (x/y/scale/opacity) instead.
findings.fixHint: replace left with the transform equivalent (x), e.g. tl.fromTo("#playhead", { x: -1300 }, { x: 0, ...yourAnimation }). Transforms interpolate sub-pixel and stay smooth at any speed.

findings.message: This HTML composition file has 547 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.
